metadata.description: Small, sharp Claude Code commands: answer briefly, audit what you have built, clean up after yourself, drive native macOS apps, recover what you last asked, keep what Claude remembers accurate, run multi-agent workflows without burning the budget, and keep what you ship reviewed, fast, and improving.

plugins.name: efmtu
plugins.description: "Easy For Me To Understand" - answer short and simple. Three sentences or five bullets, answer first, plain words - without letting brevity turn a hedge into a false promise.

plugins.name: my-skills
plugins.description: Inventory every command, skill, agent, hook and routine you have authored, sorted generic to personal to private, so you know what is safe to publish before you publish it.

plugins.name: chrome-tabs
plugins.description: Close the Chrome tabs this session opened, and only those - so agents stop leaving orphaned tab groups behind. Requires the Claude in Chrome extension.

plugins.name: mac-control
plugins.description: Drive native macOS apps via the computer-use MCP - Word/Pages PDF export, Finder, Preview, Messages, System Settings. Includes the per-app permission tiers that decide what will actually work.

plugins.name: ultracode-lite
plugins.description: Run multi-agent Workflow orchestration on a lean budget: scout inline, fan out narrow, set model and effort on every agent (they inherit your expensive session defaults otherwise), pipeline instead of parallel, and verify only what is expensive to get wrong. Installs as /ultracode-lite.

plugins.name: c-assistant
plugins.description: Triage every Claude Code session you have open and report which ones are blocked on you - the question each one asked, what only you can do, and where two sessions are duplicating work. Includes /c-assistant-voice, a spoken variant for when your hands are busy.

plugins.name: refresh
plugins.description: Show the last prompt you actually typed, word for word, read from the session transcript on disk rather than from a summarized context.

plugins.name: product-forge
plugins.description: A propose/apply loop that keeps a product competitive without letting it sprawl: weekly review against the tools people actually choose, filtered hard for small and genuinely useful, applied only after you approve each numbered item.

plugins.name: perf-pass
plugins.description: A dedicated performance session for an app you maintain - idle CPU, memory, GPU cost - with measured before/after numbers as the only accepted proof, and a hard rule against touching a running copy.

plugins.name: skill-forge
plugins.description: A propose/apply loop that audits everything you have authored for Claude - commands, skills, helper scripts, published plugins - finds real defects with quotable fixes, and applies only the numbered items you approve.

plugins.name: memory-curate
plugins.description: Audit what Claude remembers across sessions and propose fixes: stale facts, duplicates, oversized files, and memories trapped in a project you no longer open. Proposes only - nothing is written until you approve numbered items.

plugins.name: synth-mode
plugins.description: A style contract for any text a real person will read. Kills the tells that make writing read as generated: trope phrases, over-polish, research recited back at the reader. Named for Fallout 4's synths - the good ones pass.

plugins.name: voidharbor
plugins.description: The whole set in one install - all twelve skills, namespaced /voidharbor:<name>. Install this bundle, or pick skills a la carte below.
